text:
jules: pushed a quick PR to refresh the Quickstart auth + single-file deploy. main goals: replace deprecated REDWOOD_TOKEN mentions, show REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere, add a tiny streaming "next steps" link, and tighten curl example headers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1473

ana: nice. couple asks: include explicit npm/yarn install for the SDK, and show how to use an .env file with docker run.

sam: also call out that realtime/streaming examples live in /docs/advanced/streaming so we don't bloat the quickstart. leave a one-sentence pointer.

jules: updated: added `npm i @redwood/inference-sdk@^6.0.0` and a one-liner: `docker run --env-file .env redwood-hello`. swapped curl to include Content-Type and used `-d` consistently.

ci-bot: checks started for PR #1473: lint, linkcheck, doctests.

jules: left a short Troubleshooting note: "401s: confirm REDWOOD_API_KEY present, verify key scope includes generation, and check host/container clock".

ci-bot: lint: passed. linkcheck: failed on one internal anchor.

jules: fixing anchor to absolute path /security/keys-and-rotation.

ci-bot: doctests: failing because examples require live key. recommend using the docs mock helper.

sam: PR #1440 landed with the mock helper yesterday. can you rebase and rerun?

jules: rebased and added note to PR description to rerun CI after merge. marking as blocked until tests green.

doc-bot: summary: PR #1473 updates quickstart to prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY, adds install + docker env-file guidance, links to streaming docs as next steps, tightens curl example, and adds troubleshooting. Blocked pending docs test helper runs.

ana: LGTM aside from nit about a tiny wording tweak on the env var examples.

jules: fixed wording. will ping reviewers after CI passes. :rocket:
